![Aalborg, Denmark](/images/emccx/Aalborg-City.jpg){fig-alt="Aalborg, Denmark"}


The [10th Conference on Econometric Models of Climate Change (EMCC-X)](emcc-x.qmd) will be held at [Aalborg University](https://en.aau.dk/), Denmark, on August 20-21, 2026.

The conference will be held at CREATE, Department of Architecture, Design, and Media Technology at Aalborg University. [Rendsburggade 14, 9000 Aalborg.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MuY1dPZksKR6hGvr8)

# Draft Program *(version as of July 29, 2026)*

## Day 1 -  20th of August

#### 08:30-09:00	Registration Open
#### 09:10-09:20	Welcome
#### 09:20-10:20	Talk Slot 1: Climate Econometrics and Applied Evidence

- **Alessandro Giovannelli** — Forecasting ENSO with High-Dimensional time series. 
- **Feridoon Koohi-Kamali** — The dynamic common corelated spill-over effects estimation of budget neutral environmental policy & risk preference for transition to a low carbon economy-with application to the OECD. 
- **Mikkel Bennedsen** — The kinematics of global temperature: Semiparametric analysis of trend, warming rate, and acceleration.

#### 10:20-10:50	Break

#### 10:50-12:00	Spotlight Slot 1: Methods in Climate Time-Series Econometrics

- **José Alves** — Climate Resilience and the Adaptation Trap: A Macroeconomic Framework for Joint Fiscal–External Sustainability.
- **Giacomo Toscano** — Nonparametric estimation of temperature shock volatility.
- **Yin Shi** — Forecasting Carbon Dioxide Emissions in Canada: An Empirical Macroeconomic Framework.
- **Dennis Cordes** — Modeling Spatio-Temporal Peer Effects in Count Data for Residential Photovoltaic Adoption.
- **Ruriko Yoshida** — Inference on Edge Weights and Temporal Lags in Discrete Max-Linear Bayesian Networks.
- **Cheyenne Amoroso** — A Dynamic Nonlinear Panel Decomposition Model for the Global Environmental Kuznets Curve.
- **Sebastian Mathias Jensen** — Neural networks for nonlinear regression with serially correlated disturbances: Evidence from cloud cover.

#### 12:00-13:00	Lunch

#### 13:00-14:00	Talk Slot 2: Arctic Dynamics and Sea Ice

- **Alessandra Canepa** — From Shocks to Feedbacks: Regime-Dependent Persistence in   Arctic Temperature Anomalies.
- **Siem Jan Koopman** — An assessment of statistical predictive models for Arctic sea ice projections.
- **Felix Pretis** — Who Opens the Arctic: The Impact of Sea Ice and Global Economic Shocks on Arctic Vessel Traffic.

#### 14:00-14:30	Break

#### 14:30-15:40 Spotlight Slot 2: Climate-Growth and Macroeconomic Impacts

- **Sachintha Fernando** — Donor Pool Selection in Synthetic Controls: Lessons from Carbon tax Evaluations.
- **Stefano Ninfole** — Econometric Modelling of Norwegian CO2 Emissions.
- **Haodong Qi** — Climate Risks and Subjective Well-being: Insights from Human Flourishing Geographic Index (USA, 2013-2023).
- **Dhruv Akshay Pandit** — The impacts of weather anomalies on international tourism demand.
- **Francisco Javier Martinez Ramirez** — The effects of temperature and rainfall anomalies on macroeconomic variables: The case of Mexico.
- **Niki Demosthenous** — Heterogeneous Firm Belief Updating to Climate News Shocks.
- **Marina Friedrich** — Evaluating the robustness of REDD+ project impacts on avoided deforestation in Amazonian Brazil across synthetic control methods.

#### 15:40-16:10	Break

#### 16:10-17:30 Talk Slot 3: Extremes, Hazards, and Adaptation

- **Moritz Schwarz** — Using the statistical IAM-emulator statIAM to empirically constrain energy system results.
- **Marco Bidoia** — Dynamic Models for Climate Extremes.
- **Chenhui Wang** — Estimation and inference for the persistence of extremely high temperatures.
- **Markus Fritsch** — On the process of threshold exceedances of precipitation series under unknown heterogeneity and dependence.

#### 17:30	END OF DAY 1

#### 18:30	Dinner at [Det Glade Vanvid](https://detgladevanvid.dk/aalborg/).

---

## Day 2 - 21st of August

#### 09:00-10:20 Talk Slot 4: Climate-Growth and Macroeconomic Impacts

- **Luca Benati** — Estimating the Long-Run Impact of Climate Change on GDP.
- **Marius Just** — Evidence on the Climate-Growth Relationship.
- **Menghan Yuan** — Interactive Climate Effects on Economic Growth.
- **C. Vladimir Rodríguez-Caballero** — Economic Outlook from Climate Conditions.

#### 10:20-10:50	Break

#### 10:50-12:00 Spotlight Slot 3: Energy Systems and Renewable Transitions

- **Diego Alejandro Prieto Melo** — Quantifying the Quiet Creep: Degradation of 15,000 Wind Turbines in Germany.
- **Shanmukha Srinivas Byrukuri Gangadhar** — Experience with Extreme Events and Wind Energy Impact: Causal Evidence from Flood Exposure, Wind Energy, and Housing Markets.
- **Carolina García-Martos** — Structural Changes in Trend-Seasonal Decompositions for Climate and Energy Time Series.
- **Reza Modarres** — Meteorological drought volatility in Iranian areas has either increased or decreased during 1952-2022.
- **Subir Sen** — Extreme Climatic Events and Insurance Consumption: A Study of selected Asian Economies.
- **Sania Wadud** — Persistence in Chinese Climate Policy Uncertainty
- **Matthias Wirth** — Recovering continuous-time parameters of a k-box energy balance model from a discrete-time CVAR.

#### 12:00-13:00	Lunch

#### 13:00-14:00 Talk Slot 5: Carbon, Emissions, and Climate Policy

- **Paul Haimerl** — Identifying the Carbon Sink Saturation Threshold.
- **Tobias Eibinger** — Zero fare, cleaner air? The causal effect of free public transportation on transport emissions.
- **Bent Jesper Christensen** — Intermittency and the potential of wind energy for CO2 abatement.

#### 14:00-14:30	Break 

#### 14:30-15:30 Talk Slot 6: Methods in Climate Time-Series Econometrics

- **Giovanni Urga** — Common Green Bubbles Detection in Real Time.
- **Philipp Sibbertsen** — Change-Point Testing for Spectral Densities under Cyclical Long Memory.
- **Tommaso Proietti** — Trend Filtering with Fractional Splines.

#### 15:30-15:45	Closing Remarks

#### 15:45	END OF CONFERENCE
